# diyaz.

> Personal portfolio and technical blog of Diyaz Yakubov — software engineer, full-stack developer, and founder based in Helsinki, Finland.

## About

Diyaz Yakubov is a software engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable web applications, distributed systems, and cloud-native solutions. He holds a Master's degree in Software Engineering from Tampere University (Finland) and a Bachelor's in Computer Engineering from EKSTU (Kazakhstan). He is the founder of TopTop.dev, a software development company serving SMBs in the Nordic region.

## Areas of Expertise

- Software Architecture, Microservices, Domain-Driven Design
- Full-Stack Development: C#/.NET, TypeScript, React, Angular, Node.js
- Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- Data: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch
- AI & Emerging Tech: LLMs, OpenAI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, WebAssembly
- Published researcher in edge and cloud computing (Cluster Computing 2026; ESOCC 2025, Springer LNCS)

## Projects

- [TopTop.dev](https://toptop.dev): Custom software development company — cloud solutions and AI-powered services for Nordic SMBs
- [busypipe](https://busypipe.com): Social intelligence platform for TikTok — track portfolios of competitors, influencers, hashtags, and sounds with growth, engagement, and regional performance analytics. Instagram and YouTube next
- [EuroJackpot Stats](https://eurojackpotstats.eu): Lottery number generator with statistical analysis of every draw since 2012, 6 strategies, 22 languages
- [DayWatch](https://github.com/DiyazY/daywatch): Open-source cross-platform tray app that reads time-blocked markdown plans and sends native task-switch notifications (Python, MIT)

## Research

- [Di-Select](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10586-026-06269-5): Criteria-driven framework for selecting container orchestration distributions in cloud and edge computing — seven evaluation constructs and fifteen causal propositions, derived via structured literature review and grounded theory. Cluster Computing 29(8), 2026, open access
- [IoT Edge Kubernetes](https://github.com/DiyazY/iot-edge): Comparative analysis of five lightweight Kubernetes distributions on edge hardware, covering performance, resource efficiency, security, resilience, and maintainability. Published as two chapters in ESOCC 2025 (Springer LNCS)
- [di-agent](https://github.com/DiyazY/di-agent): Context-aware autonomous orchestration agent for resource-constrained edge nodes, making scheduling and offloading decisions without a central control plane. Doctoral research at Tampere University

## In Development

Salpon (salpon.com), ScandiCity (scandicity.com), mdfi (mdfi.ai)

## Blog Topics

Technical deep-dives covering AI engineering and LLM tooling, developer productivity systems, .NET and React, WebAssembly, memory management, cloud and edge computing, speculative design, and DIY maker projects.
